Tauri only hands dragging to\n * elements it owns (`data-tauri-drag-region`), and handing this one straight\n * to `startDragging()` on pointerdown swallows the click, so the drag only\n * starts once the pointer has actually travelled.\n */\nfunction bindPill(): void {\n  const pill = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#pill\");\n  if (!pill) return;\n  let origin: { x: number; y: number } | undefined;\n  let dragged = false;\n\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerdown\", (event) => {\n    if (event.button !== 0) return;\n    origin = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };\n    dragged = false;\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointermove\", (event) => {\n    if (!origin || dragged) return;\n    if (Math.abs(event.clientX - origin.x) + Math.abs(event.clientY - origin.y) < 4) return;\n    dragged = true;\n    void Promise.resolve(windowHandle.startDragging()).catch(() => undefined);\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"pointerup\", () => {\n    origin = undefined;\n  });\n  pill.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    // A click that ended a drag is the drag finishing, not a request to reopen.\n    if (dragged) {\n      dragged = false;\n      return;\n    }\n    restoreFromPill();\n  });\n}\n\n/** Titlebar controls: resize, minimize, and shut down for the session. */\nfunction bindWindowChrome(): void {\n  renderResizeControl();\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#resize\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", toggleWindowSize);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#hide\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", minimizeToPill);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#shutdown\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    // The process is about to go: journal the run first so the next launch can\n    // rebuild it, and hand the trace over as a client shutdown rather than a\n    // completed shift — a shutdown never submits a score.\n    persistRun();\n    endRun(\"client_closed\");\n    void invoke(\"shutdown\").catch(() => undefined);\n  });\n  bindPill();\n}\n\nfunction drawGate(): void {\n  screen = \"gate\";\n  screenElement.innerHTML = gateMarkup();\n  screenElement.dataset.screen = \"gate\";\n  renderAccountChip();\n  renderSignInBar();\n}\n\n/** Called once a session exists: leave the gate and show the arcade. */\nfunction unlockTui(user: AuthUser): void {\n  setSignedInUser(user);\n  openInitialScreen();\n  renderAccountChip();\n  renderSignInBar();\n}\n\n/**\n * Takes ownership of the stored save, if it is this account's. A record left by\n * someone else on the same machine is left alone rather than deleted — it is\n * still their run, and they will be handed it again when they sign back in.\n */\nfunction adoptSavedGame(ownerId: string): void {\n  const saved = loadSavedGame();\n  savedGame = saved?.ownerId === ownerId ? saved : undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Where a launch lands. Classes are cleared\n// on a timer instead of `animationend` so `prefers-reduced-motion` — which\n// collapses durations to ~0 — still shows the static markers defined in\n// index.html for the same beat.\n\nfunction setText(el: HTMLElement, text: string): void {\n  if (el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;\n}\n\n/** Write the HUD's `<strong>` values left to right, skipping unchanged ones. */\nfunction setHud(values: readonly string[]): void {\n  const spans = screenElement.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(\".game-hud span strong\");\n  values.forEach((value, index) => {\n    const el = spans[index];\n    if (el) setText(el, value);\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * The arena draws itself entirely on the canvas, so the in-place update is\n * one hand-off of the playable view — clock, feed, waiting parties and the\n * open decision included.\n */\nfunction arenaView(activeGame: PlayableGame): RestaurantArenaState {\n  const withView = activeGame as PlayableGame & { view?: () => unknown };\n  return (withView.view ? withView.view() : activeGame.state()) as RestaurantArenaState;\n}\n\nfunction updateRestaurantArena(activeGame: PlayableGame): boolean {\n  const mount = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-phaser-mount]\");\n  if (!mount) return false;\n  restaurantArenaScene?.render(arenaView(activeGame));\n  refreshInterventionPanel(activeGame);\n  return true;\n}\n\n// ── Player intervention panel ────────────────────────────────────────\n//\n// The only piece of arena chrome in the DOM rather than on the canvas:\n// natural-language guidance needs a real text input, which Phaser has no\n// primitive for. ` · ${workerModel.version}` : \"\"}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * What the shared model account is doing to this shift, and the timer that\n * takes the banner down if the transport goes quiet. \"live\" : undefined): void {\n  const status = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-mode]\");\n  if (!status) return;\n  status.textContent = message;\n  if (tone) status.dataset.tone = tone;\n  else delete status.dataset.tone;\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerStatus(role: Role | \"expediter\", status: \"idle\" | \"thinking\" | \"acting\" | \"error\"): void {\n  restaurantArenaScene?.setWorkerStatus(role, status);\n}\n\nfunction addWorkerActivity(message: string): void {\n  workerActivity.unshift(message);\n  workerActivity.splice(8);\n  const feed = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-activity]\");\n  if (!feed) return;\n  feed.replaceChildren(...workerActivity.map((entry) => {\n    const item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.textContent = entry;\n    return item;\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction stopWorkerOrchestrator(): void {\n  workerOrchestrator?.stop();\n  workerOrchestrator = undefined;\n  // Leaving the shift ends the wait it described; a banner counting down over\n  // the menu would be describing requests nobody is making.\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  workerBudget = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\n}\n\ninterface WorkerModelResponse {\n  text: string;\n  queueMs: number;\n  providerMs: number;\n  inputTokens?: number;\n  outputTokens?: number;\n  cachedInputTokens?: number;\n  finishReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** Absent provider fields (no usage on this response) stay absent, not zero. */\nfunction workerModelMetrics(response: WorkerModelResponse): ModelCallMetrics {\n  return {\n    queueMs: response.queueMs,\n    providerMs: response.providerMs,\n    ...(response.inputTokens !== undefined ? { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`);\n      // A shift held back by the shared account is waiting, not broken (#281).\n      // Only the banner is suppressed; the feed above still records the turn.\n      if (!shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) return;\n      setWorkerMode(`Fallback · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${turn.role}: ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`, \"error\");\n    },\n    onTick: (report: OrchestratorTick) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator || game !== activeGame) return;\n      for (const turn of report.turns) {\n        if (turn.status === \"accepted\") {\n          setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"acting\");\n          addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: applied ${turn.action?.tool ?? \"action\"}`);\n        }\n        else if (turn.status === \"fallback\" || turn.status === \"rejected\") setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      }\n      // Turns landing again is proof the account is answering, whatever the\n      // last throttle said was left on its countdown.\n      if (report.turns.every((turn) => turn.status === \"accepted\")) setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR);\n      drawGame();\n    },\n  });\n  workerOrchestrator = orchestrator;\n}\n\n/** Every control funnels through here — the panel's only write path. */\nfunction submitIntervention(input: PlayerInterventionInput): void {\n  if (!game) return;\n  const withIntervene = game as PlayableGame & {\n    submitPlayerIntervention?: (i: PlayerInterventionInput) => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } };\n  };\n  if (!withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention) return;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention(input);\n  if (result.accepted) {\n    setInterveneStatus(\"Sent.\");\n  } else {\n    setInterveneStatus(result.error?.message ?? }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction would just double up on-canvas\n * controls the player already has.\n */\nfunction renderGameScreen(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  const header = isArena\n    ? \"\"\n    : `<header class=\"playing-heading\"><button type=\"button\" id=\"inline-back\" class=\"inline-back\">‹ Menu</button><div>${playingHeadingTitles(entry, variationCursor)}${replaying ? '<small class=\"mode-title\">Replay</small>' : \"\"}<small class=\"personal-best\"${best ? \"\" : \" hidden\"}>Personal best ${best ?? \"\"}</small></div><button type=\"button\" data-restart aria-label=\"Restart game\">↻ Restart</button></header>`;\n  screenElement.innerHTML = `${header}${renderNativeGame(game)}`;\n  screenElement.dataset.screen = \"game\";\n  screenElement.dataset.game = game.name;\n  const mount = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-phaser-mount]\");\n  if (mount && isArena) {\n    const mountScene = () => {\n      if (!mount.isConnected || !game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n      restaurantArenaScene = mountRestaurantArenaScene(\n        mount,\n        arenaView(game),\n        (action) => performAction(action),\n        handleSceneUi,\n      );\n      bindInterventionPanel();\n      refreshInterventionPanel(game);\n      setWorkerMode();\n    };\n    // Let the flex/grid layout settle so Phaser boots at the real stage size,\n    // not a half-laid-out box that leaves the floor painted in a corner.\n    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(mountScene));\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Every repaint is also where the run's clock is re-read: an action can be what\n * ends the shift, and it can be what starts it (the doors opening) or stops it\n * (a decision card), so the scheduler is re-entered here rather than at each of\n * the dozen call sites that change the state.\n */\nfunction drawGame(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const patch = screenElement.dataset.game === \"restaurant-arena\" ? updateRestaurantArena : undefined;\n  if (patch?.(game)) setPersonalBest();\n  else renderGameScreen();\n  if (game.isOver()) finishRun();\n  else scheduleRun();\n}\n\n\ninterface ArenaDebrief {\n  grade: string;\n  headline: string;\n  met: boolean;\n  targets?: { label: string; value: string; requirement: string; met: boolean }[];\n  lines: { label: string; value: string; good: boolean }[];\n  lessons: string[];\n}\n\n/** The service report: what the shift scored, and what to fix next run. */\nfunction getArenaDebriefHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  const view = arenaView(game) as unknown as { debrief?: ArenaDebrief };\n  const debrief = view.debrief;\n  if (!debrief) return \"\";\n  // Whatever the target checks already reported is dropped here: showing\n  // \"Takings $96\" twice, once as a verdict and once as a stat, made the card\n  // longer without making it say more.\n  const checked = new Set((debrief.targets ?? []).map((target) => target.label.toLowerCase()));\n  const lines = debrief.lines\n    .filter((line) => !checked.has(line.label.toLowerCase()))\n    .map(\n      (line) =>\n        `<span class=\"debrief-stat${line.good ? \" is-good\" : \"\"}\"><small>${escapeHtml(line.label)}</small><strong>${escapeHtml(line.value)}</strong></span>`,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n  const lessons = debrief.lessons.map((lesson) => `<li>${escapeHtml(lesson)}</li>`).join(\"\");\n  // The verdict names which condition decided it. `lines` below are a\n  // read-at-a-glance summary of the shift on their own thresholds, which are\n  // not tonight's pass bar — keeping the two apart is what stops a green\n  // \"Walkouts 2\" from sitting under a MISSED verdict it actually caused.\n  const targets = (debrief.targets ?? [])\n    .map(\n      (target) =>\n        `<li class=\"debrief-check${target.met ? \" is-met\" : \"\"}\">` +\n        `<span class=\"check-mark\">${target.met ? \"met\" : \"miss\"}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-label\">${escapeHtml(target.label)}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-value\">${escapeHtml(target.value)}</span>` +\n        `<span class=\"check-req\">needs ${escapeHtml(target.requirement)}</span>` +\n        `</li>`,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `\n    <div class=\"arena-debrief\"${debrief.met ? ' data-met=\"yes\"' : \"\"}>\n      <p class=\"debrief-scope\">Local gameplay summary · not an official evaluation</p>\n      <p class=\"debrief-target\">${debrief.met ? \"LOCAL TARGET MET\" : \"LOCAL TARGET MISSED\"}</p>\n      <p class=\"debrief-grade\"><strong>${escapeHtml(debrief.grade)}</strong> ${escapeHtml(debrief.headline)}</p>\n      ${targets ? `<p class=\"debrief-criteria\">Local target checks</p><ul class=\"debrief-checks\">${targets}</ul>` : \"\"}\n      <p class=\"debrief-criteria\">Raw operational facts</p>\n      <div class=\"debrief-stats\">${lines}</div>\n      <p class=\"debrief-caveat\">No wait figure: the engine derives only a whole-shift clock reading, not an arrival-to-seat measurement.</p>\n      <ul class=\"debrief-lessons\">${lessons}</ul>\n    </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * The evidence receipt: what the shift actually recorded, counted off the\n * run's own journal — the same events `Export Trace` writes out as\n * restaurant-arena-trace/v3.\n *\n * Split by who authored each event, because that split is the whole point of\n * the export: what the house did on its own (`system`) has to stay separable\n * from what the manager handed over (`player`) and what the workers did with\n * it. Every number here is counted, never estimated, and nothing is\n * attributed to a model that did not stamp the event itself.\n */\nfunction getArenaEvidenceHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  const journal = game as unknown as { getRecordedEvents?: () => { actorId?: string; model?: unknown; toolResult?: { ok?: boolean } | null }[] };\n  if (typeof journal.getRecordedEvents !== \"function\") return \"\";\n  let events: { actorId?: string; model?: unknown; toolResult?: { ok?: boolean } | null }[];\n  try {\n    events = journal.getRecordedEvents();\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to read the arena event journal:\", err);\n    return \"\";\n  }\n  const system = events.filter((event) => event.actorId === \"system\").length;\n  const manager = events.filter((event) => event.actorId === \"player\").length;\n  const worker = events.length - system - manager;\n  const rejected = events.filter((event) => event.toolResult?.ok === false).length;\n  const modelStamped = events.filter((event) => event.model !== undefined && event.model !== null).length;\n  // Only the authorship split gets tiles — that split is what the export is\n  // for. The rest is one line, because a six-tile grid made a footnote look\n  // like a scoreboard.\n  const rows: [string, string][] = [\n    [\"System\", `${system}`],\n    [\"Your handover\", `${manager}`],\n    [\"Worker turns\", `${worker}`],\n  ];\n  return `\n    <div class=\"arena-evidence\">\n      <p class=\"debrief-criteria\">${events.length} recorded events · exported by <code>Export Trace</code></p>\n      <div class=\"evidence-stats\">${rows\n        .map(([label, value]) => `<span class=\"evidence-stat\"><small>${escapeHtml(label)}</small><strong>${escapeHtml(value)}</strong></span>`)\n        .join(\"\")}</div>\n      <p class=\"debrief-caveat\">${rejected} rejected call${rejected === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"} · ${modelStamped} stamped by a model. Counted from this run&rsquo;s journal, never inferred.</p>\n    </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * The session id, on screen, at the end of the shift.\n *\n * Retrieving one person's contributed session means matching what they played\n * against what arrived (#281), and until now nothing on screen named the run:\n * the id existed only inside the exported file and the chunk stream. A tester\n * on their own machine had nothing to quote back.\n */\nfunction sessionReceiptHtml(): string {\n  if (!sessionReceiptId) return \"\";\n  return `\n    <p class=\"session-receipt\">\n      <small>Session ID</small>\n      <code data-session-id>${escapeHtml(sessionReceiptId)}</code>\n    </p>`;\n}\n\n/** Decision and correction timeline viewer for the shift end-screen. */\nfunction getArenaTimelineHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  try {\n    const timeline = buildArenaTimeline(game as unknown as RestaurantGame);\n    return renderTimelineHtml(timeline);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to build arena timeline:\", err);\n    return \"\";\n  }\n}\n\n/** Export the raw restaurant-arena-trace-v3 JSON or JSONL file. */\nfunction exportCurrentTrace(format: \"json\" | \"jsonl\" = \"json\"): void {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  try {\n    // A shift played in the overlay is live gameplay by definition; synthetic\n    // and benchmark traces are produced by scripts/export-arena-trace.ts.\n    const trace = captureArenaTrace(game as unknown as RestaurantGame, {\n      runKind: \"live\",\n      ...(sessionReceiptId ? { sessionId: sessionReceiptId } : {}),\n    });\n    const content = format === \"jsonl\" ? exportTraceJsonl(trace) : exportTraceJson(trace);\n    // Named by session, not episode: `episodeId` is the scenario, so every\n    // run of the same seed used to download over the last one (#281).\n    const filename = `restaurant-arena-trace-${trace.sessionId ?? trace.episodeId}.${format === \"jsonl\" ? \"jsonl\" : \"json\"}`;\n    const mimeType = format === \"jsonl\" ? \"application/x-ndjson\" : \"application/json\";\n    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n    const a = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    a.href = url;\n    a.download = filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(a);\n    a.click();\n    a.remove();\n    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n\n    const btn = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-action=\"export-trace\"]');\n    if (btn) {\n      const orig = btn.innerHTML;\n      btn.innerHTML = \"Exported!\";\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = orig;\n      }, 2000);\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to export trace:\", err);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── Run lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n//\n// One run is on the floor at a time. Every launch goes through launchRun(), and\n// every way a run stops goes through finishRun() (it ended on its own terms) or\n// endRun() (something took it off the floor). Keeping those two apart is what\n// keeps the promises in the README straight: only a finished shift submits a\n// score and clears the save, and only a restart throws the save away.\n\n/** Seeds stay inside the 32-bit range the engines index with. */\nconst SEED_LIMIT = 2 ** 31;\n\n/**\n * A seed for a new run. `replacing` is the seed a restart is throwing away:\n * restart means \"a different night\", never \"deal that one again\", so the single\n * seed it must not return is that one.\n */\nfunction randomSeed(replacing?: number): number {\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt += 1) {\n    const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * SEED_LIMIT);\n    if (seed !== replacing) return seed;\n  }\n  // Eight collisions against one excluded value never happens in practice; the\n  // fallback is here so the function cannot fail to return a usable seed.\n  return ((replacing ?? 0) + 1) % SEED_LIMIT;\n}\n\n/** Actions the house takes on its own, rather than ones the player chose. */\nfunction isEnvironmentAction(action: string): boolean {\n  return action === \"tick\" || action === \"bot_move\";\n}\n\nfunction clearTickTimer(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(tickTimer);\n  tickTimer = undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Arms whatever advances the clock — and only ever one of them. With a live\n * crew the orchestrator owns the cadence, because it steps `tick` itself at the\n * end of each decision round; without one the shell is the clock. Either way\n * the engine's own `tickMs()` decides whether the clock should be running at\n * all: it returns 0 for every idle state (before the doors open, while a\n * decision card waits on the manager, after the shift ends), so this is\n * re-entered on every repaint rather than latched at launch.\n */\nfunction scheduleRun(): void {\n  clearTickTimer();\n  if (!game || gameEnded || replaying) return;\n  const interval = runPause.isPaused() ? 0 : game.tickMs();\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    if (interval > 0) workerOrchestrator.start();\n    else workerOrchestrator.pause();\n    return;\n  }\n  if (interval <= 0) return;\n  tickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {\n    tickTimer = undefined;\n    if (!game || gameEnded || runPause.isPaused()) return;\n    // Through performAction so the beat is journalled, saved and drawn like any\n    // other action; drawGame() arms the next one.\n    performAction(\"tick\");\n  }, interval);\n}\n\n/** Stops the clock for `reason`. The run keeps its place on the floor. */\nfunction holdRun(reason: PauseReason): void {\n  runPause.hold(reason);\n  clearTickTimer();\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n}\n\n/** Drops one hold. The run only moves again once nothing else is holding it. */\nfunction releaseRun(reason: PauseReason): void {\n  if (!runPause.release(reason)) return;\n  scheduleRun();\n}\n\n/**\n * Journals the run so the next launch can rebuild it: the seed, plus the\n * accepted actions in order (`overlay/persistence.ts`).\n *\n * Only actions the shell applied reach `runActions`, so a shift a live crew is\n * driving cannot be described this way — the orchestrator applies worker turns\n * straight to the engine. Rather than keep a record that would resume a\n * *different* night under this one's name, such a run keeps no record at all.\n */\nfunction persistRun(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry || replaying || gameEnded) return;\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    clearSavedGame();\n    savedGame = undefined;\n    return;\n  }\n  const variation = entry.variations[variationCursor];\n  if (!variation) return;\n  const save: SavedGame = {\n    schemaVersion: 1,\n    ownerId: signedInUser()?.id ?? \"\",\n    gameId: entry.id,\n    gameVersion: entry.version,\n    variationId: variation.id,\n    seed: runSeed,\n    actions: [...runActions],\n  };\n  savedGame = saveGame(save) ? save : undefined;\n}\n\ninterface LaunchOptions {\n  /** Reuse a stored seed instead of dealing a new night. */\n  seed?: number;\n  /** A run already rebuilt from the save record. */\n  restored?: { game: PlayableGame; actions: string[] };\n}\n\n/** Puts a run on the floor and shows it. The one way a game starts. */\nfunction launchRun(selected: GameEntry, variationIndex: number, options: LaunchOptions = {}): void {\n  const variation = selected.variations[variationIndex];\n  if (!selected.create || !variation) return;\n  // Whatever was on the floor is left behind, not completed.\n  endRun(\"user_quit\");\n  entry = selected;\n  cursor = MENU_GAMES.indexOf(selected);\n  variationCursor = variationIndex;\n  runSeed = options.seed ?? randomSeed();\n  const restored = options.restored;\n  game = restored?.game ?? selected.create(variation.id);\n  if (!restored) game.reset(runSeed);\n  runActions = restored ? [...restored.actions] : [];\n  actionsTaken = runActions.length;\n  gameStartedAt = Date.now();\n  gameEnded = false;\n  replaying = false;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  activeTrace = createOverlayTrace(selected, variation.id, runSeed);\n  gameSessionId = activeTrace.gameId;\n  sessionReceiptId = gameSessionId;\n  // A resumed run's actions were all applied by the shell under the same actor\n  // rule performAction uses, so replaying that rule rebuilds the journal for\n  // the part of the night that already happened instead of guessing at it.\n  for (const action of runActions) {\n    appendOverlayAction(activeTrace, action, isEnvironmentAction(action) ? \"environment\" : \"human\");\n  }\n  persistTrace(activeTrace);\n  attachWorkerOrchestrator(game);\n  screen = \"game\";\n  captureOverlayEvent(\n    \"game.started\",\n    { game_type: selected.id, variation_id: variation.id },\n    gameSessionId,\n  );\n  renderGameScreen();\n  persistRun();\n  scheduleRun();\n}\n\n/** `gamepigeon:launch` and `?game=` both name a game and variation by id. */\nfunction launchById(gameId: string, variationId?: string | null): boolean {\n  const selected = MENU_GAMES.find(({ id }) => id === gameId);\n  if (!selected || !isPlayable(selected)) return false;\n  // An unknown or missing variation opens the first one: `classic` is the\n  // host's default for games that have no modes of their own.\n  const index = selected.variations.findIndex(({ id }) => id === variationId);\n  launchRun(selected, index < 0 ? 0 : index);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Rebuilds the saved run action-by-action and puts it back on the floor.\n * Returns false when the record can no longer describe this build, having\n * dropped it: resuming a run that is not the one the record names would be\n * worse than starting from the menu.\n */\nfunction resumeSavedGame(): boolean {\n  const saved = savedGame;\n  if (!saved) return false;\n  const selected = MENU_GAMES.find(({ id }) => id === saved.gameId);\n  const variationIndex = selected?.variations.findIndex(({ id }) => id === saved.variationId) ?? -1;\n  const restored = selected ? restoreGame(selected, saved) : null;\n  // A run that was already over when it was saved has nothing to go back to,\n  // and finishing it again would submit a second score for the same night.\n  if (!selected || variationIndex < 0 || !restored || restored.game.isOver()) {\n    clearSavedGame();\n    savedGame = undefined;\n    return false;\n  }\n  launchRun(selected, variationIndex, { seed: saved.seed, restored });\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Start over: a new run of the same game and variation, on a seed that is never\n * the one being replaced, with the old save thrown away (README).\n */\nfunction restartRun(): void {\n  if (!entry) return;\n  const selected = entry;\n  const variationIndex = variationCursor;\n  const replaced = runSeed;\n  closeDialog();\n  endRun(\"restart\");\n  clearSavedGame();\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  launchRun(selected, variationIndex, { seed: randomSeed(replaced) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Ends the shift and goes back to the menu, leaving the save exactly as it is\n * (README): the seed and the action log still describe this run, so it can be\n * resumed from the menu or on the next launch.\n */\nfunction leaveToMenu(): void {\n  persistRun();\n  endRun(\"user_quit\");\n  closeDialog();\n  screen = \"menu\";\n  cursor = entry ? MENU_GAMES.indexOf(entry) : -1;\n  drawMenu();\n}\n\n/**\n * Takes the run off the floor without finishing it. `reason` seals its trace —\n * a shift that ended on its own terms was already sealed by finishRun, so this\n * only ever reports the runs that stopped for some other reason, and none of\n * them carry a score.\n */\nfunction endRun(reason: EpisodeEndReason): void {\n  clearTickTimer();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  runPause.clear();\n  if (activeTrace && !gameEnded) submitTrace(activeTrace, reason);\n  activeTrace = undefined;\n  game = undefined;\n  gameEnded = true;\n}\n\n/**\n * The shift ran to its own end. This is the only path that submits a score, so\n * it is also the only one that has to be safe to reach twice: every repaint\n * asks whether the run is over, and a completed run stays on screen.\n */\nfunction finishRun(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry || gameEnded) return;\n  gameEnded = true;\n  clearTickTimer();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n\n  const score = game.score();\n  const won = game.hasWon();\n  const variationId = entry.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? \"classic\";\n  const completedAt = new Date();\n  // The night is over, so the save has nothing left to resume. Left behind it\n  // would offer a finished shift as \"Resume\" and submit its score a second time.\n  clearSavedGame();\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  if (activeTrace) {\n    submitTrace(activeTrace, won ? \"won\" : \"lost\", score);\n    activeTrace = undefined;\n  }\n  captureOverlayEvent(\"game.ended\", {\n    game_type: entry.id,\n    variation_id: variationId,\n    outcome: \"completed\",\n    score,\n    success: won,\n    duration_ms: Math.max(0, completedAt.getTime() - gameStartedAt),\n    actions_taken: actionsTaken,\n  }, gameSessionId);\n  void invoke(\"append_local_score\", {\n    score: {\n      game_id: gameSessionId,\n      game_type: entry.id,\n      variation_id: variationId,\n      score,\n      success: won,\n      completed_at: completedAt.toISOString(),\n      duration_ms: Math.max(0, completedAt.getTime() - gameStartedAt),\n      platform: \"overlay\",\n    },\n  }).then(() => refreshLocalScores()).catch(() => undefined);\n  showGameEndOverlay(score, won);\n}\n\n/**\n * The end card, over the board it belongs to. The service report, the evidence\n * receipt and the timeline are all read off the finished game, which is why the\n * run stays loaded after finishRun() — and why the card is what offers the two\n * ways out rather than dropping the player back on the menu automatically.\n */\nfunction showGameEndOverlay(score: number, won: boolean): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const board = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\".board\");\n  if (!board) return;\n  board.querySelector(\".game-end-overlay\")?.remove();\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, score);\n  const overlay = document.createElement(\"div\");\n  overlay.className = \"game-end-overlay\";\n  overlay.dataset.tone = won ? \"win\" : \"loss\";\n  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class=\"game-end-content${isArena ? \" arena-end-content\" : \"\"}\">\n    <h2 class=\"game-end-title\">${won ? \"Shift complete\" : \"Shift over\"}</h2>\n    <p class=\"game-end-stats\">Score ${score}${best === undefined ? \"\" : ` · Personal best ${best}`}</p>\n    ${getArenaDebriefHtml()}\n    ${getArenaEvidenceHtml()}\n    ${getArenaTimelineHtml()}\n    ${sessionReceiptHtml()}\n    <div class=\"game-end-actions\">\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"primary\" data-restart><kbd>R</kbd> Play again</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-menu>‹ Menu</button>\n      ${isArena ? `<div class=\"export-trace-group\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"export-trace-btn\" data-action=\"export-trace\">Export Trace</button>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"export-trace-btn-alt\" data-action=\"export-trace-jsonl\">JSONL</button>\n      </div>` : \"\"}\n    </div>\n  </div>`;\n  board.append(overlay);\n  overlay.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-restart]\")?.focus();\n}\n\n/**\n * The canvas dispatches these from inside a Phaser input handler, and both menu\n * and restart tear the scene down — emitter included, mid-dispatch — so the\n * shell's answer waits for the next task.\n */\nfunction handleSceneUi(action: \"menu\" | \"restart\" | \"help\"): void {\n  window.setTimeout(() => {\n    if (action === \"menu\") leaveToMenu();\n    else if (action === \"restart\") restartRun();\n    else openDialog(\"how-to-play\");\n  }, 0);\n}\n\n// ── Dialogs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n//\n// Three cards live in index.html rather than in #screen, because they sit over\n// whatever the screen is showing: the pause card, How to Play, and the sign-out\n// confirmation. Only one is ever up, and while any of them is up the run is\n// held under the \"dialog\" hold — so closing How to Play can never resume a\n// shift the agent paused.\n\nconst DIALOG_SELECTORS: Record<DialogId, string> = {\n  pause: \"#return-prompt\",\n  \"how-to-play\": \"#how-to-play\",\n  signout: \"#signout-prompt\",\n};\n\nfunction dialogElement(id: DialogId): HTMLElement | null {\n  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(DIALOG_SELECTORS[id]);\n}\n\n/** How to Play opened off the pause card goes back to it, not to the floor. */\nlet howToPlayReturnsToPause = false;\n\n/**\n * The pause card describes the run behind it, so it is written on every open.\n * The agent can stop the player on the same beat a shift ends, and then there\n * is nothing to continue — see pausePrompt().\n */\nfunction renderPauseCard(): void {\n  const prompt = dialogElement(\"pause\");\n  if (!prompt) return;\n  const running = screen === \"game\" && game ? A throttle gets no\n * follow-up report -- the next request simply happens later -- so the\n * countdown is what clears it.\n */\nlet workerBudget: WorkerBudgetState = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\nlet workerBudgetTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;\n\nfunction setWorkerBudget(state: WorkerBudgetState): void {\n  workerBudget = state;\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  const message = workerBudgetMessage(state, workerModelLabel());\n  if (!message) {\n    setWorkerMode();\n    return;\n  }\n  setWorkerMode(message, \"waiting\");\n  workerBudgetTimer = setTimeout(() => setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR), workerBudgetHoldMs(state));\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerMode(message = workerModelLabel(), tone: \"live\" | \"pending\" | \"waiting\" | \"error\" | undefined = workerModel ? \"live\" : undefined): void {\n  const status = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-mode]\");\n  if (!status) return;\n  status.textContent = message;\n  if (tone) status.dataset.tone = tone;\n  else delete status.dataset.tone;\n}\n\nfunction setWorkerStatus(role: Role | \"expediter\", status: \"idle\" | \"thinking\" | \"acting\" | \"error\"): void {\n  restaurantArenaScene?.setWorkerStatus(role, status);\n}\n\nfunction addWorkerActivity(message: string): void {\n  workerActivity.unshift(message);\n  workerActivity.splice(8);\n  const feed = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLOListElement>(\"[data-arena-worker-activity]\");\n  if (!feed) return;\n  feed.replaceChildren(...workerActivity.map((entry) => {\n    const item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.textContent = entry;\n    return item;\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction stopWorkerOrchestrator(): void {\n  workerOrchestrator?.stop();\n  workerOrchestrator = undefined;\n  // Leaving the shift ends the wait it described; a banner counting down over\n  // the menu would be describing requests nobody is making.\n  if (workerBudgetTimer !== undefined) clearTimeout(workerBudgetTimer);\n  workerBudgetTimer = undefined;\n  workerBudget = WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR;\n}\n\ninterface WorkerModelResponse {\n  text: string;\n  queueMs: number;\n  providerMs: number;\n  inputTokens?: number;\n  outputTokens?: number;\n  cachedInputTokens?: number;\n  finishReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** Absent provider fields (no usage on this response) stay absent, not zero. */\nfunction workerModelMetrics(response: WorkerModelResponse): ModelCallMetrics {\n  return {\n    queueMs: response.queueMs,\n    providerMs: response.providerMs,\n    ...(response.inputTokens !== undefined ? { inputTokens: response.inputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.outputTokens !== undefined ? { outputTokens: response.outputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.cachedInputTokens !== undefined ? { cachedInputTokens: response.cachedInputTokens } : {}),\n    ...(response.finishReason !== undefined ? { finishReason: response.finishReason } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attachWorkerOrchestrator(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (!workerModel || activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  const arena = activeGame as unknown as RestaurantGame;\n  const client = new WorkerModelClient({\n    retries: 0,\n    // The Rust transport bounds the provider call and starts that bound after\n    // the request budget admits it, so queue time is not charged to the\n    // worker. A timer here would start while the request is still in line and\n    // abort a crew that is only waiting its turn.\n    timeoutMs: null,\n    complete: async (request: ModelRequest, signal: AbortSignal) => {\n      const role = request.observation.role;\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\n      setWorkerStatus(role, \"thinking\");\n      // A request already queued behind the account's share is not pending on\n      // the model; the budget banner is the more specific thing to say. The\n      // activity feed still logs the request either way -- it is a log of what\n      // happened, not a description of the current state.\n      if (shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) setWorkerMode(`Pending · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${role}`, \"pending\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${role}: requested live action`);\n      const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();\n      const cancel = () => void invoke(\"cancel_worker_model\", { requestId });\n      signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", cancel, { once: true });\n      try {\n        const response = await invoke<WorkerModelResponse>(\"complete_worker_model\", {\n          requestId,\n          request: { systemPrompt: request.systemPrompt, turnPrompt: request.turnPrompt },\n        });\n        if (signal.aborted) throw new Error(\"model request canceled\");\n        setWorkerStatus(role, \"acting\");\n        addWorkerActivity(`${role}: response received in ${Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)}ms`);\n        return { text: response.text, metrics: workerModelMetrics(response) };\n      } finally {\n        signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", cancel);\n      }\n    },\n  });\n  let orchestrator: WorkerOrchestrator;\n  orchestrator = new WorkerOrchestrator(arena, {\n    client,\n    model: workerModel,\n    tickIntervalMs: () => arena.tickMs() || 1_000,\n    onError: (turn) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator) return;\n      setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: fallback — ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`);\n      // A shift held back by the shared account is waiting, not broken (#281).\n      // Only the banner is suppressed; the feed above still records the turn.\n      if (!shouldReportFallback(workerBudget)) return;\n      setWorkerMode(`Fallback · ${workerModelLabel()} · ${turn.role}: ${turn.error ?? \"invalid action\"}`, \"error\");\n    },\n    onTick: (report: OrchestratorTick) => {\n      if (workerOrchestrator !== orchestrator || game !== activeGame) return;\n      for (const turn of report.turns) {\n        if (turn.status === \"accepted\") {\n          setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"acting\");\n          addWorkerActivity(`${turn.role}: applied ${turn.action?.tool ?? \"action\"}`);\n        }\n        else if (turn.status === \"fallback\" || turn.status === \"rejected\") setWorkerStatus(turn.role, \"error\");\n      }\n      // Turns landing again is proof the account is answering, whatever the\n      // last throttle said was left on its countdown.\n      if (report.turns.every((turn) => turn.status === \"accepted\")) setWorkerBudget(WORKER_BUDGET_CLEAR);\n      drawGame();\n    },\n  });\n  workerOrchestrator = orchestrator;\n}\n\n/** Every control funnels through here — the panel's only write path. */\nfunction submitIntervention(input: PlayerInterventionInput): void {\n  if (!game) return;\n  const withIntervene = game as PlayableGame & {\n    submitPlayerIntervention?: (i: PlayerInterventionInput) => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } };\n  };\n  if (!withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention) return;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = withIntervene.submitPlayerIntervention(input);\n  if (result.accepted) {\n    setInterveneStatus(\"Sent.\");\n  } else {\n    setInterveneStatus(result.error?.message ?? \"Could not send that.\", \"error\");\n  }\n  // A rejected stale/invalid intervention must not strand live workers in the\n  // paused state either; drawGame() re-enters the selected scheduler.\n  drawGame();\n}\n\n/** Wire the static shell once per mount; content refreshes in place after. */\nfunction bindInterventionPanel(): void {\n  const els = interveneEls();\n  if (!els.toggle || !els.panel) return;\n  interveneRole = \"chef\";\n\n  els.toggle.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    const opening = els.panel!.hidden;\n    els.panel!.hidden = !opening;\n    els.toggle!.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", String(opening));\n    if (opening && game) refreshInterventionPanel(game);\n  });\n  els.close?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    els.panel!.hidden = true;\n    els.toggle!.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", \"false\");\n  });\n  els.roles?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-role]\");\n    if (!target?.dataset.role) return;\n    interveneRole = target.dataset.role as PlayerInterventionInput[\"targetRole\"];\n    els.roles!.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-role]\").forEach((btn) => btn.classList.toggle(\"is-selected\", btn === target));\n  });\n  els.send?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    const text = els.text?.value.trim() ?? \"\";\n    if (!text) {\n      setInterveneStatus(\"Say something first.\", \"error\");\n      return;\n    }\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"message\", targetRole: interveneRole, text, priority: els.urgent?.checked ? Doing\n  // nothing and choosing to do nothing read identically in a trace otherwise.\n  els.pass?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (!game) return;\n    const withPass = game as PlayableGame & { passRound?: () => { accepted: boolean; error?: { message: string } } };\n    if (!withPass.passRound) return;\n    workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n    const result = withPass.passRound();\n    setInterveneStatus(result.accepted ? \"Round passed.\" : result.error?.message ?? \"Could not pass.\", result.accepted ? \"ok\" : \"error\");\n    drawGame();\n  });\n  els.tickets?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-order-id]\");\n    if (!target || target.hasAttribute(\"data-already-high\")) return;\n    submitIntervention({ kind: \"priority\", targetRole: interveneRole, orderId: target.dataset.orderId!, priority: \"high\" });\n  });\n  els.approve?.addEventListener(\"click\", (event) => {\n    const target = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-decision-id]\");\n    if (!target?.dataset.decisionId || !target.dataset.optionId) return;\n    submitIntervention({\n      kind: \"approve\",\n      targetRole: (target.dataset.speakerRole as PlayerInterventionInput[\"targetRole\"]) ?? interveneRole,\n      decisionId: target.dataset.decisionId,\n      optionId: target.dataset.optionId,\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/** Refill the ticket list and the approve/deny section from the live view — never the message box, so an in-progress draft survives a tick. */\nfunction refreshInterventionPanel(activeGame: PlayableGame): void {\n  if (activeGame.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  const els = interveneEls();\n  if (!els.panel) return;\n  const view = arenaView(activeGame);\n\n  const live = (view.orders ?? !round.canAct;\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (els.approve) {\n    const decision = view.decision;\n    if (decision) {\n      els.approve.hidden = false;\n      els.approve.innerHTML =\n        `<p class=\"arena-intervene-label\">${decision.speaker} needs a call — ${decision.title}</p>` +\n        decision.options\n          .map(\n            (option) =>\n              `<button type=\"button\" }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The header's personal best climbs with the live score, so it has to be\n * refreshed on the in-place path too — `renderGameScreen` only runs on launch.\n */\nfunction setPersonalBest(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const el = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\".playing-heading .personal-best\");\n  if (!el) return;\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  el.hidden = !best;\n  if (best) setText(el, `Personal best ${best}`);\n}\n\n/**\n * Full repaint — only for entering a game, since it drops every animation.\n * Restaurant Arena draws its own transport controls, HUD and now its own\n * menu/restart on the canvas (see the hotspot() comment in the scene), so it\n * gets no DOM header at all — that chrome would just double up on-canvas\n * controls the player already has.\n */\nfunction renderGameScreen(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, game.score());\n  const header = isArena\n    ? \"\"\n    : `<header updateRestaurantArena : undefined;\n  if (patch?.(game)) setPersonalBest();\n  else renderGameScreen();\n  if (game.isOver()) finishRun();\n  else scheduleRun();\n}\n\n\ninterface ArenaDebrief {\n  grade: string;\n  headline: string;\n  met: boolean;\n  targets?: { label: string; value: string; requirement: string; met: boolean }[];\n  lines: { label: string; value: string; good: boolean }[];\n  lessons: string[];\n}\n\n/** The service report: what the shift scored, and what to fix next run. */\nfunction getArenaDebriefHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  const view = arenaView(game) as unknown as { debrief?: ArenaDebrief };\n  const debrief = view.debrief;\n  if (!debrief) return \"\";\n  // Whatever the target checks already reported is dropped here: showing\n  // \"Takings $96\" twice, once as a verdict and once as a stat, made the card\n  // longer without making it say more.\n  const checked = new Set((debrief.targets ?? []).map((target) => target.label.toLowerCase()));\n  const lines = debrief.lines\n    .filter((line) => !checked.has(line.label.toLowerCase()))\n    .map(\n      (line) =>\n        `<span class=\"debrief-stat${line.good ? \" is-good\" : \"\"}\"><small>${escapeHtml(line.label)}</small><strong>${escapeHtml(line.value)}</strong></span>`,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n  const lessons = debrief.lessons.map((lesson) => `<li>${escapeHtml(lesson)}</li>`).join(\"\");\n  // The verdict names which condition decided it. `lines` below are a\n  // read-at-a-glance summary of the shift on their own thresholds, which are\n  // not tonight's pass bar — keeping the two apart is what stops a green\n  // \"Walkouts 2\" from sitting under a MISSED verdict it actually caused.\n  const targets = (debrief.targets ?? Every number here is counted, never estimated, and nothing is\n * attributed to a model that did not stamp the event itself.\n */\nfunction getArenaEvidenceHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  const journal = game as unknown as { getRecordedEvents?: () => { actorId?: string; model?: unknown; toolResult?: { ok?: boolean } | null }[] };\n  if (typeof journal.getRecordedEvents !== \"function\") return \"\";\n  let events: { actorId?: string; model?: unknown; toolResult?: { ok?: boolean } | null }[];\n  try {\n    events = journal.getRecordedEvents();\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to read the arena event journal:\", err);\n    return \"\";\n  }\n  const system = events.filter((event) => event.actorId === \"system\").length;\n  const manager = events.filter((event) => event.actorId === \"player\").length;\n  const worker = events.length - system - manager;\n  const rejected = events.filter((event) => event.toolResult?.ok === false).length;\n  const modelStamped = events.filter((event) => event.model !== undefined && event.model !== null).length;\n  // Only the authorship split gets tiles — that split is what the export is\n  // for. The rest is one line, because a six-tile grid made a footnote look\n  // like a scoreboard.\n  const rows: [string, string][] = [\n    [\"System\", `${system}`],\n    [\"Your handover\", `${manager}`],\n    [\"Worker turns\", `${worker}`],\n  ];\n  return `\n    <div class=\"arena-evidence\">\n      <p class=\"debrief-criteria\">${events.length} recorded events · exported by <code>Export Trace</code></p>\n      <div class=\"evidence-stats\">${rows\n        .map(([label, value]) => `<span class=\"evidence-stat\"><small>${escapeHtml(label)}</small><strong>${escapeHtml(value)}</strong></span>`)\n        .join(\"\")}</div>\n      <p class=\"debrief-caveat\">${rejected} rejected call${rejected === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"} · ${modelStamped} stamped by a model. Counted from this run&rsquo;s journal, never inferred.</p>\n    </div>`;\n}\n\n/**\n * The session id, on screen, at the end of the shift.\n *\n * Retrieving one person's contributed session means matching what they played\n * against what arrived (#281), and until now nothing on screen named the run:\n * the id existed only inside the exported file and the chunk stream. A tester\n * on their own machine had nothing to quote back.\n */\nfunction sessionReceiptHtml(): string {\n  if (!sessionReceiptId) return \"\";\n  return `\n    <p class=\"session-receipt\">\n      <small>Session ID</small>\n      <code data-session-id>${escapeHtml(sessionReceiptId)}</code>\n    </p>`;\n}\n\n/** Decision and correction timeline viewer for the shift end-screen. */\nfunction getArenaTimelineHtml(): string {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return \"\";\n  try {\n    const timeline = buildArenaTimeline(game as unknown as RestaurantGame);\n    return renderTimelineHtml(timeline);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to build arena timeline:\", err);\n    return \"\";\n  }\n}\n\n/** Export the raw restaurant-arena-trace-v3 JSON or JSONL file. */\nfunction exportCurrentTrace(format: \"json\" | \"jsonl\" = \"json\"): void {\n  if (!game || game.name !== \"restaurant-arena\") return;\n  try {\n    // A shift played in the overlay is live gameplay by definition; synthetic\n    // and benchmark traces are produced by scripts/export-arena-trace.ts.\n    const trace = captureArenaTrace(game as unknown as RestaurantGame, {\n      runKind: \"live\",\n      ...(sessionReceiptId ? trace.episodeId}.${format === \"jsonl\" ? \"jsonl\" : \"json\"}`;\n    const mimeType = format === \"jsonl\" ? \"application/x-ndjson\" : \"application/json\";\n    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n    const a = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    a.href = url;\n    a.download = filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(a);\n    a.click();\n    a.remove();\n    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n\n    const btn = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-action=\"export-trace\"]');\n    if (btn) {\n      const orig = btn.innerHTML;\n      btn.innerHTML = \"Exported!\";\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = orig;\n      }, 2000);\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"Failed to export trace:\", err);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── Run lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n//\n// One run is on the floor at a time. Every launch goes through launchRun(), and\n// every way a run stops goes through finishRun() (it ended on its own terms) or\n// endRun() (something took it off the floor). Keeping those two apart is what\n// keeps the promises in the README straight: only a finished shift submits a\n// score and clears the save, and only a restart throws the save away.\n\n/** Seeds stay inside the 32-bit range the engines index with. */\nconst SEED_LIMIT = 2 ** 31;\n\n/**\n * A seed for a new run. `replacing` is the seed a restart is throwing away:\n * restart means \"a different night\", never \"deal that one again\", so the single\n * seed it must not return is that one.\n */\nfunction randomSeed(replacing?: number): number {\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt += 1) {\n    const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * SEED_LIMIT);\n    if (seed !== replacing) return seed;\n  }\n  // Eight collisions against one excluded value never happens in practice; the\n  // fallback is here so the function cannot fail to return a usable seed.\n  return ((replacing ?? 0) + 1) % SEED_LIMIT;\n}\n\n/** Actions the house takes on its own, rather than ones the player chose. */\nfunction isEnvironmentAction(action: string): boolean {\n  return action === \"tick\" || action === \"bot_move\";\n}\n\nfunction clearTickTimer(): void {\n  if (tickTimer !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(tickTimer);\n  tickTimer = undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * Arms whatever advances the clock — and only ever one of them. With a live\n * crew the orchestrator owns the cadence, because it steps `tick` itself at the\n * end of each decision round; without one the shell is the clock. Either way\n * the engine's own `tickMs()` decides whether the clock should be running at\n * all: it returns 0 for every idle state (before the doors open, while a\n * decision card waits on the manager, after the shift ends), so this is\n * re-entered on every repaint rather than latched at launch.\n */\nfunction scheduleRun(): void {\n  clearTickTimer();\n  if (!game || gameEnded || replaying) return;\n  // A game with no `tickMs` never advances on its own; it waits for the player.\n  const interval = runPause.isPaused() ? 0 : game.tickMs?.() ?? 0;\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    if (interval > 0) workerOrchestrator.start();\n    else workerOrchestrator.pause();\n    return;\n  }\n  if (interval <= 0) return;\n  tickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {\n    tickTimer = undefined;\n    if (!game || gameEnded || runPause.isPaused()) return;\n    // Through performAction so the beat is journalled, saved and drawn like any\n    // other action; drawGame() arms the next one.\n    performAction(\"tick\");\n  }, interval);\n}\n\n/** Stops the clock for `reason`. The run keeps its place on the floor. */\nfunction holdRun(reason: PauseReason): void {\n  runPause.hold(reason);\n  clearTickTimer();\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n}\n\n/** Drops one hold. The run only moves again once nothing else is holding it. */\nfunction releaseRun(reason: PauseReason): void {\n  if (!runPause.release(reason)) return;\n  scheduleRun();\n}\n\n/**\n * Journals the run so the next launch can rebuild it: the seed, plus the\n * accepted actions in order (`overlay/persistence.ts`).\n *\n * Only actions the shell applied reach `runActions`, so a shift a live crew is\n * driving cannot be described this way — the orchestrator applies worker turns\n * straight to the engine. Rather than keep a record that would resume a\n * *different* night under this one's name, such a run keeps no record at all.\n */\nfunction persistRun(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry || replaying || gameEnded) return;\n  if (workerOrchestrator) {\n    clearSavedGame();\n    savedGame = undefined;\n    return;\n  }\n  const variation = entry.variations[variationCursor];\n  if (!variation) return;\n  const save: SavedGame = {\n    schemaVersion: 1,\n    ownerId: signedInUser()?.id ?? \"\",\n    gameId: entry.id,\n    gameVersion: entry.version,\n    variationId: variation.id,\n    seed: runSeed,\n    actions: [...runActions],\n  };\n  savedGame = saveGame(save) ? save : undefined;\n}\n\ninterface LaunchOptions {\n  /** Reuse a stored seed instead of dealing a new night. */\n  seed?: number;\n  /** A run already rebuilt from the save record. */\n  restored?: { game: PlayableGame; actions: string[] };\n}\n\n/** Puts a run on the floor and shows it. The one way a game starts. */\nfunction launchRun(selected: GameEntry, variationIndex: number, options: LaunchOptions = {}): void {\n  const variation = selected.variations[variationIndex];\n  if (!selected.create || !variation) return;\n  // Whatever was on the floor is left behind, not completed.\n  endRun(\"user_quit\");\n  entry = selected;\n  cursor = MENU_GAMES.indexOf(selected);\n  variationCursor = variationIndex;\n  runSeed = options.seed ?? randomSeed();\n  const restored = options.restored;\n  game = restored?.game ?? selected.create(variation.id);\n  if (!restored) game.reset(runSeed);\n  runActions = restored ? [...restored.actions] : [];\n  actionsTaken = runActions.length;\n  gameStartedAt = Date.now();\n  gameEnded = false;\n  replaying = false;\n  workerActivity.length = 0;\n  activeTrace = createOverlayTrace(selected, variation.id, runSeed);\n  gameSessionId = activeTrace.gameId;\n  sessionReceiptId = gameSessionId;\n  // A resumed run's actions were all applied by the shell under the same actor\n  // rule performAction uses, so replaying that rule rebuilds the journal for\n  // the part of the night that already happened instead of guessing at it.\n  for (const action of runActions) {\n    appendOverlayAction(activeTrace, action, isEnvironmentAction(action) ? \"environment\" : \"human\");\n  }\n  persistTrace(activeTrace);\n  attachWorkerOrchestrator(game);\n  screen = \"game\";\n  captureOverlayEvent(\n    \"game.started\",\n    { game_type: selected.id, variation_id: variation.id },\n    gameSessionId,\n  );\n  renderGameScreen();\n  persistRun();\n  scheduleRun();\n}\n\n/** `gamepigeon:launch` and `?game=` both name a game and variation by id. */\nfunction launchById(gameId: string, variationId?: string | null): boolean {\n  const selected = MENU_GAMES.find(({ id }) => id === gameId);\n  if (!selected || !isPlayable(selected)) return false;\n  // An unknown or missing variation opens the first one: `classic` is the\n  // host's default for games that have no modes of their own.\n  const index = selected.variations.findIndex(({ id }) => id === variationId);\n  launchRun(selected, index < 0 ? 0 : index);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Rebuilds the saved run action-by-action and puts it back on the floor.\n * Returns false when the record can no longer describe this build, having\n * dropped it: resuming a run that is not the one the record names would be\n * worse than starting from the menu.\n */\nfunction resumeSavedGame(): boolean {\n  const saved = savedGame;\n  if (!saved) return false;\n  const selected = MENU_GAMES.find(({ id }) => id === saved.gameId);\n  const variationIndex = selected?.variations.findIndex(({ id }) => id === saved.variationId) ?? -1;\n  const restored = selected ? restoreGame(selected, saved) : null;\n  // A run that was already over when it was saved has nothing to go back to,\n  // and finishing it again would submit a second score for the same night.\n  if (!selected || variationIndex < 0 || !restored || restored.game.isOver()) {\n    clearSavedGame();\n    savedGame = undefined;\n    return false;\n  }\n  launchRun(selected, variationIndex, { seed: saved.seed, restored });\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Start over: a new run of the same game and variation, on a seed that is never\n * the one being replaced, with the old save thrown away (README).\n */\nfunction restartRun(): void {\n  if (!entry) return;\n  const selected = entry;\n  const variationIndex = variationCursor;\n  const replaced = runSeed;\n  closeDialog();\n  endRun(\"restart\");\n  clearSavedGame();\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  launchRun(selected, variationIndex, { seed: randomSeed(replaced) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Ends the shift and goes back to the menu, leaving the save exactly as it is\n * (README): the seed and the action log still describe this run, so it can be\n * resumed from the menu or on the next launch.\n */\nfunction leaveToMenu(): void {\n  persistRun();\n  endRun(\"user_quit\");\n  closeDialog();\n  screen = \"menu\";\n  cursor = entry ? MENU_GAMES.indexOf(entry) : -1;\n  drawMenu();\n}\n\n/**\n * Takes the run off the floor without finishing it. `reason` seals its trace —\n * a shift that ended on its own terms was already sealed by finishRun, so this\n * only ever reports the runs that stopped for some other reason, and none of\n * them carry a score.\n */\nfunction endRun(reason: EpisodeEndReason): void {\n  clearTickTimer();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n  restaurantArenaScene?.destroy();\n  restaurantArenaScene = undefined;\n  runPause.clear();\n  if (activeTrace && !gameEnded) submitTrace(activeTrace, reason);\n  activeTrace = undefined;\n  game = undefined;\n  gameEnded = true;\n}\n\n/**\n * The shift ran to its own end. This is the only path that submits a score, so\n * it is also the only one that has to be safe to reach twice: every repaint\n * asks whether the run is over, and a completed run stays on screen.\n */\nfunction finishRun(): void {\n  if (!game || !entry || gameEnded) return;\n  gameEnded = true;\n  clearTickTimer();\n  cancelTraceFlush();\n  stopWorkerOrchestrator();\n\n  const score = game.score();\n  const won = game.hasWon();\n  const variationId = entry.variations[variationCursor]?.id ?? \"classic\";\n  const completedAt = new Date();\n  // The night is over, so the save has nothing left to resume. Left behind it\n  // would offer a finished shift as \"Resume\" and submit its score a second time.\n  clearSavedGame();\n  savedGame = undefined;\n  if (activeTrace) {\n    submitTrace(activeTrace, won ? \"won\" : \"lost\", score);\n    activeTrace = undefined;\n  }\n  captureOverlayEvent(\"game.ended\", {\n    game_type: entry.id,\n    variation_id: variationId,\n    outcome: \"completed\",\n    score,\n    success: won,\n    duration_ms: Math.max(0, completedAt.getTime() - gameStartedAt),\n    actions_taken: actionsTaken,\n  }, gameSessionId);\n  void invoke(\"append_local_score\", {\n    score: {\n      game_id: gameSessionId,\n      game_type: entry.id,\n      variation_id: variationId,\n      score,\n      success: won,\n      completed_at: completedAt.toISOString(),\n      duration_ms: Math.max(0, completedAt.getTime() - gameStartedAt),\n      platform: \"overlay\",\n    },\n  }).then(() => refreshLocalScores()).catch(() => undefined);\n  showGameEndOverlay(score, won);\n}\n\n/**\n * The end card, over the board it belongs to. The service report, the evidence\n * receipt and the timeline are all read off the finished game, which is why the\n * run stays loaded after finishRun() — and why the card is what offers the two\n * ways out rather than dropping the player back on the menu automatically.\n */\nfunction showGameEndOverlay(score: number, won: boolean): void {\n  if (!game || !entry) return;\n  const board = screenElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>(\".board\");\n  if (!board) return;\n  board.querySelector(\".game-end-overlay\")?.remove();\n  const isArena = game.name === \"restaurant-arena\";\n  const best = personalBest(entry.id, score);\n  const overlay = document.createElement(\"div\");\n  overlay.className = \"game-end-overlay\";\n  overlay.dataset.tone = won ? \"win\" : \"loss\";\n  overlay.innerHTML = `<div class=\"game-end-content${isArena ? \" arena-end-content\" : \"\"}\">\n    <h2 class=\"game-end-title\">${won ? \"Shift complete\" : \"Shift over\"}</h2>\n    <p class=\"game-end-stats\">Score ${score}${best === undefined ? \"\" : ` · Personal best ${best}`}</p>\n    ${getArenaDebriefHtml()}\n    ${getArenaEvidenceHtml()}\n    ${getArenaTimelineHtml()}\n    ${sessionReceiptHtml()}\n    <div class=\"game-end-actions\">\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"primary\" data-restart><kbd>R</kbd> Play again</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-menu>‹ Menu</button>\n      ${isArena ? `<div class=\"export-trace-group\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"export-trace-btn\" data-action=\"export-trace\">Export Trace</button>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"export-trace-btn-alt\" data-action=\"export-trace-jsonl\">JSONL</button>\n      </div>` : \"\"}\n    </div>\n  </div>`;\n  board.append(overlay);\n  overlay.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"[data-restart]\")?.focus();\n}\n\n/**\n * The canvas dispatches these from inside a Phaser input handler, and both menu\n * and restart tear the scene down — emitter included, mid-dispatch — so the\n * shell's answer waits for the next task.\n */\nfunction handleSceneUi(action: \"menu\" | \"restart\" | \"help\"): void {\n  window.setTimeout(() => {\n    if (action === \"menu\") leaveToMenu();\n    else if (action === \"restart\") restartRun();\n    else openDialog(\"how-to-play\");\n  }, 0);\n}\n\n// ── Dialogs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n//\n// Three cards live in index.html rather than in #screen, because they sit over\n// whatever the screen is showing: the pause card, How to Play, and the sign-out\n// confirmation. Only one is ever up, and while any of them is up the run is\n// held under the \"dialog\" hold — so closing How to Play can never resume a\n// shift the agent paused.\n\nconst DIALOG_SELECTORS: Record<DialogId, string> = {\n  pause: \"#return-prompt\",\n  \"how-to-play\": \"#how-to-play\",\n  signout: \"#signout-prompt\",\n};\n\nfunction dialogElement(id: DialogId): HTMLElement | null {\n  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(DIALOG_SELECTORS[id]);\n}\n\n/** How to Play opened off the pause card goes back to it, not to the floor. */\nlet howToPlayReturnsToPause = false;\n\n/**\n * The pause card describes the run behind it, so it is written on every open.\n * The agent can stop the player on the same beat a shift ends, and then there\n * is nothing to continue — see pausePrompt().\n */\nfunction renderPauseCard(): void {\n  const prompt = dialogElement(\"pause\");\n  if (!prompt) return;\n  const running = screen === \"game\" && game ? -1;\n  localScores = { personal_bests: [], recent: [], top_scores: [] };\n  drawGate();\n}\n\n/** Wire the shell's three cards once; their content is written on open. */\nfunction bindDialogs(): void {\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#return-code\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", backToCoding);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#continue-game\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", resumeFromPause);\n  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#how-to-play-from-pause\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    howToPlayReturnsToPause = true;\n    openDialog(\"how-to-play\");\n  });\n document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(\"#signout-cancel\")?.addEventListener(\"click\", closeDialog);\n}\n\n/** A card up owns the keyboard; the screen behind it never sees these keys. */\nfunction handleDialogKey(event: KeyboardEvent): void {\n  if (!openDialogId) return;\n  if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    if (openDialogId === \"pause\")   else backToCoding();\n    return;\n  }\n  if (openDialogId === \"pause\" && event.key.toLowerCase() === \"m\") {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    leaveToMenu();\n  }\n}\n\nfunction moveMenuCursor(delta: number): void {\n  if (cursor === -1) {\n    cursor = delta > 0 ? 0 : MENU_GAMES.length - 1;\n  } else {\n    cursor = (cursor + delta + MENU_GAMES.length) % MENU_GAMES.length;\n handleSettingsKey(key: Key): void {\n  if (key === \"quit\") { screen = \"menu\"; drawMenu(); }\n}\n\nfunction genericAction(key: Key): string | null {\n  if (!game) return null;\n  const raw = typeof key === \"string\" ? key : key.char === \" \" ? \"space\" : key.char.toLowerCase();\n  const action = game.keymap?.[raw] ?? raw;\n  return (game.actions as readonly string[]).includes(action) ? action : null;\n}\n\n\nfunction performAction(action: string): boolean {\n  if (!game || replaying || game.isOver() || !(game.actions as readonly string[]).includes(action)) return false;\n  workerOrchestrator?.pause();\n  const result = stepGame(action, isEnvironmentAction(action) ? \"environment\" : \"human\");\n  actionsTaken++;\n  if (result.moved) persistRun();\n\n  drawGame();\n  return result.moved;\n}\n\nfunction stepGame(action: string, actor: TraceActor): StepResult {\n  if (!game) throw new Error(\"No active game\");\n  const result = game.step(action);\n  // Only accepted actions go in the save: `restoreGame` rebuilds by replaying\n  // it, and an action the engine refused would not move the rebuild either —\n  // it would just make the record longer than the run it describes.\n  if (result.moved) runActions.push(action);\n  if (activeTrace) {\n    appendOverlayAction(activeTrace, action, actor);\n    persistTrace(activeTrace);\n    scheduleTraceFlush(activeTrace);\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\n/** Mirror the physical key on its matching on-screen control, if any. */\nfunction setControlPressed(action: string, pressed: boolean):
